- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:660 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `POST_SYNC_TEST_REPAIR: ${{ inputs.post_sync_test_repair && 'true' || 'false' }}` reads only `inputs.*` and not `github.event.inputs.*`, so for the poller's `workflow_dispatch` run (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25544-25548`, `gh workflow run ... -f post_sync_test_repair=true`) it is claimed to resolve to `'false'`.
  WHY: With the env value at `'false'`, the gate's `clean_same_head` precondition (gate script line 591-594) never fires, so the integration test repair is skipped with skip_reason=clean_same_head and is silently lost; the adjacent `FORCE_RB_JUDGE` line (664) already uses the dual-source pattern. Both flagging reviewers rated it SEVERITY: MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it: the input is declared under both `workflow_call` (line 40) and `workflow_dispatch` (line 103), and GitHub fills `inputs` on dispatch.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3435 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The condition `if: inputs.post_sync_test_repair && ...` also reads only `inputs`, which the reviewer says fails for `workflow_dispatch`.
  WHY: Integration test repair runs dispatched via workflow_dispatch would not trigger because the condition resolves to false; reported as SEVERITY: MAJOR. minimax_minimax-m3 called this a pre-existing instance of the same anti-pattern, while anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said the line is correct.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: The new env expression reads only the `workflow_call` input. The poller's `_dispatch_integration_test_repair` (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25544-25548`) dispatches via `gh workflow run ... -f post_sync_test_repair=true` (workflow_dispatch), where, the reviewer claims, only `github.event.inputs.X` is populated, so the expression evaluates to `'false'`.
  WHY: The gate's `clean_same_head` precondition reads `POST_SYNC_TEST_REPAIR` (gate script line 591-594), so the skip is not suppressed and the integration test repair is silently lost. The fix should mirror `FORCE_RB_JUDGE` (line 664). The pre-existing line 3435 has the same anti-pattern.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:line 773 marker-time shell regex (`^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}`)
  PROBLEM: The shell regex is redundant defense-in-depth, because the Python parser already sanitizes `clean_marker_created_at` and logs `AUTOFIX_GATE_CLEAN_SAME_HEAD_CHECK outcome=error reason=marker_time_unavailable`.
  WHY: Suggested fix: drop the shell regex and rely on the Python-side validation (Estimated lines changed: -7; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
